# GNOME desktop applications that must be filed under Accessories (附件).
# Sources, verified 2026-10-22 against the current base image:
#   * RPMs: desktop files listed by the Bluefin base rpmdb for
#     nautilus, ptyxis, gnome-control-center, gnome-disk-utility,
#     gnome-system-monitor, gnome-tour, gnome-tweaks, orca.
#   * Flatpaks: Flathub appstream launchable ids for the org.gnome.* entries
#     in build_files/software/flatpaks.txt (Builder and NautilusPreviewer are
#     intentionally not desktop apps here).
